instructions: Show your working for every question.

questions.text: Write 2x + 3y = 9 in the form ax + by + c = 0.
Find two solutions of x − y = 4.
Find k if (2, 1) lies on 3x + ky = 8.
Solve x + y = 10 and x − y = 2.
The sum of two numbers is 25 and their difference is 5. Find them.
Two pens and three pencils cost ₹40; one pen and one pencil cost ₹16. Find each price.
A father is 3 times as old as his son; in 10 years he will be twice as old. Find their ages.

title: Linear equations in two variables
